2609.27621.title: SHRAV: State-Hypothesis-Reason-Action-Verify Framework for Physical Modeling and Inverse Design
2609.27621.paper_summary: Physical modeling and inverse design require computation that can continue from reusable state. We introduce SHRAV, an architecture-independent computational framework organized around State, Hypothesis, Reason, Action, and Verify. Its central mechanism is a state-continuation core with declared reuse boundaries and explicit roles for learned evolution and numerical quantities. Forward configurations evolve predictive state and read out physical responses; inverse-design configurations additionally generate target-directed modifications and consume evaluator feedback. Electromagnetic world-model studies are mapped to forward configurations, with selected readout and reuse diagnostics reported here. Computational lithography demonstrates an inverse-design configuration: four fixed-weight design updates improve thresholded aerial-image intersection-over-union from 0.5313 to 0.8153 under independent scalar-pupil replay, with maximum absolute prediction-replay difference approximately 0.000824 between predictor estimates and independent replay.
2609.27621.paper_summary_zh: 物理建模和逆向設計需要能夠從可重用狀態繼續的計算。我們介紹SHRAV，一種獨立於架構的計算框架，圍繞狀態、假設、推理、行動和驗證組織。其核心機制是一個狀態延續核心，具有明確的重用邊界和學習演化及數值量的明確角色。前向配置演化預測狀態並讀取物理響應；逆向設計配置則額外生成目標導向的修改並消耗評估者反饋。電磁世界模型研究被映射到前向配置，這裡報告了選定的讀取和重用診斷。計算光刻展示了一個逆向設計配置：四個固定權重的設計更新在獨立標量孔徑重播下，將閾值空中圖像的交集比從0.5313提高到0.8153，預測者估算和獨立重播之間的最大絕對預測重播差異約為0.000824。
2609.27621.author: Ziheng Guo et.al.
